public_base_url.description: Public base URL used to build inbound webhook callback URLs.

default_room_id.description: Webex room ID that the bot can read and post to.

default_to_person_email.description: Optional person email destination for direct messages.

bot_token.description: Optional Webex bot token. Falls back to secret store if omitted.

webhook_secret.description: Shared secret Webex uses to sign webhook requests with X-Spark-Signature.
